_doc: ERRATUM 3 (decision S2-15): the paths are first REDUCED TO THEIR ROOTS. Here they hold the group `cluster` [0,1]
AND its own child `beta` [0,1,1] (given descendant first). `beta` is not a root: it is never checked or placed
under the target on its own, and travels inside `cluster` at its unchanged path within it. The one root goes
to the bottom of the layer (index 0 after removal, counting only the layer's NON-moved children), so the
layer is [cluster[alpha, beta], solo]. Without the reduction `beta` would leave the group and land beside it.
name: moving_an_element_with_its_descendant_moves_only_the_root
